input.body:
label: feature
file: src/exportUtils.ts

This is a request for new behaviour: only "csv" and "xlsx" are currently supported (see SUPPORTED_FORMATS in src/exportUtils.ts, used throughout src/api/reports.ts and src/export/). Adding TSV would mean adding a new entry to SUPPORTED_FORMATS/CONTENT_TYPES, a delimiter option for toDelimited (which currently hardcodes commas), and a corresponding writer/content-type wiring in the export routes and scheduler. Nothing is currently broken — CSV correctly quotes fields containing commas via escapeField/NEEDS_QUOTES — so this is a feature request rather than a bug.
